entities.name: PMID:27502396
observations: In TNBC cells, uPAR interactions with uPA and IGF1R were detected by immunoprecipitation and proximity ligation assays.
Combined uPAR/uPA or uPAR/IGF1R knockdown additively reduced cell viability, migration, and invasion in model TNBC cell lines.
In a TNBC tissue cohort of 174 cases, uPAR-uPA and uPAR-IGF1R complexes correlated with histological grade and cathepsins B/D; these tissue associations are not by themselves causal.

entities.name: uPAR
observations: uPAR is PLAUR, the urokinase plasminogen activator receptor; the cited TNBC study tested its physical complexes with uPA and IGF1R and their functional contribution to malignant phenotypes.

entities.name: uPA
observations: uPA is PLAU; combined knockdown with uPAR additively reduced TNBC cell viability, migration, and invasion in the cited study.

entities.name: IGF1R
observations: IGF1R formed a detected complex with uPAR in TNBC cells; combined knockdown with uPAR additively reduced viability, migration, and invasion in model TNBC cell lines.

entities.name: Triple-negative breast cancer
observations: The cited study examined TNBC cell models and a tissue cohort of 174 TNBC cases.
